notes_for_editor: Two different Horse Heaven lookouts exist. Idaho County (Nez Perce/Payette NF, this record) and Lemhi County (ground site, Salmon NF, 45.26295, -114.54673). Source 5 and the Lemhi firelookout.com page are about the Lemhi one. The 1934 Ivan Decker staff entry is unresolved: Idaho Fire Lookouts attributes it to the Recorder Herald, but the only Recorder Herald quote we found is on the Salmon NF page. Now in events as an unresolved entry, attributed in the story to Idaho Fire Lookouts; the story says the 1934 name is not settled. The 1932 Biba entry is single-sourced. Location: the brief's Idaho Fire Lookouts coordinates (45.26993, -116.5482) do not appear in the page text we read; the FFLOS point (45.26955, -116.57609) matches firetower.org, about 2 km apart. Not resolved. Photos on firetower.org (cabin, 1930 and 2009) were not captured; no image URLs were extracted.
